metadata.description: A small set of AI tools that run inside your coding agent. feed keeps a second brain fed from your subscriptions; video-edit cuts a talking-head video without a timeline.

plugins.name: feed
plugins.description: Subscribe to YouTube channels and RSS feeds. Pulls transcripts of new items, summarises them, and files structured notes into an Obsidian vault.

plugins.name: video-edit
plugins.description: Tighten and assemble talking-head video. Pulls a clip, transcribes it, cuts false starts and dead air, overlays cutaways, renders.
